title: MIA user configuration pushed from the phone
description: The settings the Android app's Software update screen edits (ADR-0023). Data only: it is validated on the phone and again on the Pi by bin/mia-apply-update, written to /etc/mia/config.d/50-phone.json and never executed or interpolated into a shell. Pi-owned state such as voice_settings.json (ADR-0019) is not part of it.

device_name.description: Name the Pi shows to consoles.
